transactionTotalDiscountPercent_t.notes: The percentage of the Total Transaction (List)  that is discounted off of the transaction. One-time and recurring pricing for the specified contract duration are included.

annualContractListValue_t.notes: The total of contract extended values at list price within the first year, including only recurring pricing.

totalContractListValue_t.notes: The total of all contract extended values at list price for this transaction over the duration of the contract, including all one-time and recurring pricing. Equal to the Transaction Total (List).

priceScore_t.notes: The total calculated price score for this transaction, based on an average weighted price score on each line based upon total Contract Value at List price.

totalOneTimeCostAmount_t.notes: The total of extended costs for all one-time charges for the transaction.

totalMonthlyCostAmount_t.notes: The total of extended costs for all monthly recurring charges for the transaction. This is the total cost incurred each month.

totalAnnualCostAmount_t.notes: The total of recurring extended costs each year for the transaction.

totalContractCostAmount_t.notes: The total of all contract extended costs for this transaction over the duration of the contract, including all one-time and recurring costs.

winLossStatus_t.notes: The determining status of whether the transaction represents a won or a lost sale. This can be used in Deal Management analysis.

totalOneTimeMarginAmount_t.notes: The total of extended margins for all one-time charges for the transaction.

totalMonthlyMarginAmount_t.notes: The total of extended margins for all monthly recurring charges for the transaction.

totalAnnualMarginAmount_t.notes: The total of recurring extended margins each year for the transaction.

totalContractMarginAmount_t.notes: The total of all contract extended margins for this transaction over the duration of the contract, including all one-time and recurring values.

transactionMarginPercent_t.notes: The percentage of the total list price for which this transaction's margin accounts.

proposalExists_t.notes: Indicates whether the transaction has Proposal Document that can be viewed within the CRM or other integrated system.

totalRecurRevenue_t.notes: The total recurring revenues net of all discounts for this transaction.

Price score for the transaction using Margin Based calculation method.

_parent_line_item.notes: Used to identify the name of the parent line item, if any, for this subdocument.

_config_attr_text.notes: Configurable Attribute Text format is similar Configurable Attribute. The only difference is that the values correspond to the display text of the attributes.

_is_line_item_mandatory.notes: Used to identify if the line item is mandatory.

_config_attr_info.notes: Configurable Attribute Information is populated with variable name, attribute name, data type and menu type information.

_is_recommended_price.notes: Used to identify if the line item has recommended price set by a rule.

contractedPeriods_l.notes: Number of periods the customer has contracted to receive the item.

_is_part_pricing_rule_price.notes: Used to identify if a line item has a part pricing rule set by a rule

contractValue_l.notes: The total contract value of this line including all one-time and recurring charges.

_original_document_number.notes: Used to identify the document number from which the line item is copied.

createdBy_l.notes: The person that created the transaction line.

_reconfiguration_date.notes: Used to Store the Reconfiguration Date of the model. -1 for Part and non-configured Model.

createdDate_l.notes: The date when the transaction line was created.

_last_modified_date.notes: Used to Store the last modified date of the sub-document.

costAmount_l.notes: The total cost of this line.

_line_item_comment.notes: Stores the comments for the line item.

customDiscountAmount_l.notes: The amount by which to adjust the list price because of a custom discount.

_line_item_spare_rule_var_name.notes: Identifier returned by Spare Rule, if the Identifier is not specified the spare rule variable name is used as the identifier

customDiscountValue_l.notes: Used to capture the numeric value associated with the discount type. This might be an override price, amount off or percentage.

customDiscountType_l.notes: The type of custom discount to apply to this line.

contractStartDate_l.notes: Date that the customer starts to receive the service.

_part_supplier_company_name.notes: Name of the part supplier company

itemInstanceId_l.notes: The unique, invariant, internal identifier of this instance of a product. It is used to link sales order lines to the assets they change in an asset based order and as the key stored in a sales order line association. This ID is assigned when the product instance is created in either an external federated asset repository or in CPQ when a sales order line is created.

lastUpdatedBy_l.notes: The person that last updated this transaction line.

lastUpdatedDate_l.notes: The date and time the transaction line was last updated.

listAmount_l.notes: The extended list amount for this line.

listPrice_l.notes: The list price of the item.

_model_segment_name.notes: Segment to which the model belongs

_model_segment_var_name.notes: Segment to which the model belongs

_model_product_line_name.notes: Product Line to which the model belongs

_model_product_line_attributes.notes: Product Line Attributes of Product Line to which the model belongs

_model_product_line_var_name.notes: Variable name of the product line that the model belongs to.

netAmount_l.notes: The extended list amount minus any discounts for this line.

netPrice_l.notes: The price paid by the customer for the item.

pricePeriod_l.notes: The period of service purchased at this price.

priceType_l.notes: Indicates whether the amount on this line is charged once or periodically.

requestedUnitOfMeasure_l.notes: The unit of measure of the item requested by the customer (e.g. "Each").

unitCost_l.notes: The unit cost of the item.

priceWithinPolicy_l.notes: Flag which indicates if line price is within requesting user's defined pricing limits

_price_item_price_each.notes: The starting price. For Parts it will be the base price or price book price. For models it may be the base model price or the pricing rule or attribute value prices.

_price_list_price_each.notes: Will usually be the same value as the Item Price, unless a recommended item price applies.

_pricing_rule_price_each.notes: Currenly the customer level pricing. (Not applicable for Models)

_price_unit_price_each.notes: Will usually be the same value as the List Price, unless a contract price applies.

_price_configurable_price.notes: Original price as per catalog (inclusive of discount and premium)

annualDiscount_l.notes: The annual discount on the recurring charges on this line.

contractDiscount_l.notes: The total discount of this line including all one-time and recurring charges.

discountAmount_l.notes: The discount amount for this line.

itemInstanceName_l.notes: The public identifier of the instance of a product. For goods this is typically the serial #. For services it might be another identifier such as the telephone #. This does not have to be unique across all product instances (e.g. a cell phone # may be reallocated over time). It is one of the primary attributes for searching for a product instance.

requestDate_l.notes: The date on which the user requests that fulfillment occur for this transaction line.

contractEndDate_l.notes: Date that the customer stops to receive the service.

fulfillmentStatus_l.notes: The status for this line supplied by the fulfillment system after the transaction is submitted as a sales order.

_line_bom_parent_id.notes: The parent BOM item instance id.

_line_bom_attributes.notes: BOM attributes, stored as a JSON string.

_line_bom_part_number.notes: The part number of the BOM item. Only applicable to the model line.

_line_bom_item_quantity.notes: The BOM item line quantity. This is the unexploded line quantity, whereas _price_quantity stores the exploded quantity.

_line_bom_level.notes: The BOM item depth (level) in the quote.

_line_bom_effective_date.notes: System attribute to be stored in model line effective date to drive date effectivity in all BOM mappings.

_group_sequence_number.notes: Group sequence number for the subdocument.

annualListValue_l.notes: The extended value at list price for recurring pricing on this transaction line over the duration of the contracted periods.

contractListValue_l.notes: The total of all contract list value of this line, including all one-time and recurring charges.

winLossStatus_l.notes: The determining status of whether the transaction line represents a won or a lost sale. This can be used in Deal Management analysis.

priceScore_l.notes: The calculated price score for this transaction line, based on the line item's List and Net pricing.

unitMargin_l.notes: The margin for a single unit of this transaction line.

marginAmount_l.notes: The margin for all quoted units of this transaction line.

marginPercent_l.notes: The percentage of the List price for which this transaction line's margin accounts.

annualCost_l.notes: The extended cost for recurring pricing on this transaction line.

contractCost_l.notes: The total of all contract extended costs for this line, including one-time and recurring costs.

annualMargin_l.notes: The extended margin for recurring pricing on this transaction line.

contractMargin_l.notes: The total of all contract extended margins for this line, including one-time and recurring values.

_price_calculation_info.notes: JSON array of aggregated calculation information returned from advanced pricing profiles

_model_is_valid.notes: Check if model is configured or unconfigured

discountPercent_l.notes: The percentage of the Contract Value (List) that is discounted off of the transaction line.

lineType_l.notes: The type of a transaction line whether it represents a model or a part.

oRCL_ERP_OrderNumber_l.notes: The order number assigned by the external Order Management and ERP system.

priceRecurFrequency_l.notes: The periodicity or frequency of this pricing. Derived from the pricePeriod_l.

_model_partner_entity_id.notes: Partner entity id for the model

_model_partner_organization_id.notes: partner organization id for the model

rootLine_l.notes: Indicates whether the line is a root line. Root lines include only root model lines and standalone part lines.

nonRecurRevSummable_l.notes: One-time revenue net of all discounts for this line.

recurringRevSummable_l.notes: Recurring revenue net of all discounts for this line.

usageRevSummable_l.notes: Usage revenue net of all discounts for this line.

monthlyRecurRevSummable_l.notes: Monthly recurring revenues net of all discounts for this line.

monthlyUsageRevSummable_l.notes: Monthly usage revenues net of all discounts for this line.

priceTypeRollup_l.notes: Indicates whether the amount on this line is charged once or periodically. For Root model lines, this will represent a rollup of values for all child lines.

priceRecurFrequencyRollup_l.notes: The periodicity or frequency of this pricing or for the root model rolled up to include all child values.

contractedPeriodsRollup_l.notes: Number of periods the customer has contracted to receive the item or for the root model rolled up to include all child values.

listPriceRollup_l.notes: The list price of the item or for the root model rolled up to include all child values.

netPriceRollup_l.notes: The price paid by the customer for the individual item or for the root model rolled up to include all child values.

netAmountRollup_l.notes: The extended list amount minus any discounts for this line or for the root model rolled up to include all child values.

discountPercentRollup_l.notes: The percentage of the Contract Value (List) that is discounted off of the transaction line or for the root model rolled up to include all child values.

nonRecurRevRollup_l.notes: One-time revenue on this line or for the root model lines, the sum of one-time revenues for all the child lines.

recurRevRollup_l.notes: Recurring revenue on this line or for the root model lines, the sum of recurring revenues for all the child lines.

usageRevRollup_l.notes: Usage revenue on this line or for the root model lines, the sum of usage revenues for all the child lines.

contractValueRollup_l.notes: Contract value on this line or for the root model lines, the sum of all contract revenues for all the child lines.

contractListValueRollup_l.notes: Contract list value on this line or for the root model lines, the sum of all contract list values for all the child lines.

monthlyRecurRevRollup_l.notes: Monthly recurring revenue on this line or for the root model lines, the sum of monthly recurring revenues for all the child lines.

monthlyUsageRevRollup_l.notes: Monthly usage revenue on this line or for the root model lines, the sum of monthly usage revenues for all the child lines.

_config_attr_values.notes: Stores configurable attributes values in a user-friendly JSON format that are passed in from the CRM partner at the time of quote creation. These values are used as a starting point when creating quote lines from opportunity revenue lines and are not updated by subsequent reconfiguration. Usage should be limited to a small number of attributes to assure performance. Only simple configuration attribute data types are supported.

_revenueId_l.notes: The ID of the Revenue Line Item in the associated opportunity.

_revenueCategory_l.notes: Identifies the category of revenue for this line (E.g. renewal vs new business).

oRCL_ABO_ActionCode_l.notes: Indicates the changes required by the transaction line.

subscriptionId_l.notes: The unique identifier for the subscription. Used only for  subscription billing-related transactions.

subscriptionLineId_l.notes: The unique identifier for the subscription line. Used only for  subscription billing-related transactions.

parentAssetKey_l.notes: The identifier for the corresponding parent asset in an external asset repository. Used only for asset-related lines.

ownerResourceId_l.notes: The owner of the associated Opportunity Revenue Line.

lineNumber_l.notes: Line number in a line item grid is a sequential number assigned to each row or line of the grid. This is used to sort lines on the screen and in documents.

renewDate_l.notes: Renewal date of a subscription service.

suspendDate_l.notes: Suspension date of a subscription service

resumeDate_l.notes: Resuming date of a subscription service

oRCL_ABO_ComponentAttributes_l.notes: A comma separated collection of key / value pair attributes that define the configuration of this asset / component plus an action code indicating whether the attribute has changed.

orderDate_l.notes: The date and time the order was placed for fulfillment.

oRCL_SFA_InventoryOrgID_l.notes: The inventory organization in SFA used for sales products.

oRCL_SFA_Status_l.notes: The SFA status of the transaction line. This value may differ from the transaction status for CPQ. Initially, there is no internal logic setting this value.

oRCL_SFA_InventoryItemID_l.notes: The inventory item id of the sales product in SFA.

_part_sales_product_type.notes: ProductTypeCode Valid values comes from a lookup. E.g Goods, Included Warranty etc.

fulfillmentLineId_l.notes: Value that uniquely identifies the fulfillment line.

rollupFlag_l.notes: Specifies a charge component as a rollup value or aggregate value for the element code of the charge component price.

fulfillmentOrganizationCode_l.notes: Abbreviation that identifies the organization that ships the shipment.

paymentTerms_l.notes: Payment terms to apply to collect payment. Review and update the value for this attribute using the Setup and Maintenance work area, and the Manage Receivables Payment Terms task. To collect data for this attribute, use the Collect Order Reference Data task for Fusion Source.

parentDocNumber_l.notes: Document number of the parent line item.

associatedLineId_l.notes: Document number to be associated with the subscription line.

associatedOrderId_l.notes: Source order Id associated with the subscription line

requestShipDate_l.notes: The requested ship date for the order line.

changeCode_l.notes: A single select menu to handle all the possible codes to close a subscription.

changeReason_l.notes: A single select menu to handle all the possible reasons for closing a subscription.

_line_display_name.notes: Display name attribute for line items.

_line_bom_variable_name.notes: The variable name of the BOM item

_line_bom_name.notes: The name of the BOM item

_price_type.notes: Type of price (For example: One-time, Periodic - monthly, quarterly etc)

_price_period.notes: Period for which the price will be applicable.

_is_bom_price.notes: Used to identify if the line item has BOM price. Applicable for a BOM item only

includedInBasePrice.notes: Used to identify if the line item is included in the base price. Applicable for a BOM item only.

_s_coverageOrderNumber.notes: Source order number of the coverage line for OM Integration.

_line_bom_model_path.notes: The model path of the BOM item; only applicable to the model line

_s_coverageLineNumber.notes: Source line number of the coverage line for OM Integration.

_line_bom_condition_index.notes: The condition index of the BOM item

_line_bom_sequence_index.notes: The sequence index of the BOM item

_line_bom_display_name.notes: The display name of the BOM item

_s_partID_l.notes: Part number from the Items table.

_is_coverage.notes: Indicates whether the product is of coverage type

_s_freezeNegotiationFlag_l.notes: Flag indicating whether price negotiation is permitted.

_model_sales_product_type.notes: ProductTypeCode Valid values comes from a lookup. E.g Goods, Included Warranty etc.

_s_lastPricePaid_l.notes: The most recent price at which the part/model was quoted.

_s_lastPricePaidCustomerId_l.notes: The most recent price at which the part/model was quoted to the customer.

_s_priceScoreMarginBased_l.notes: Margin Based Method price score calculation for a line.

_s_priceScoreListBased_l.notes: List Based Method price score calculation for line.

_s_priceScoreWeighting_l.notes: Weighting attribute for price score calculation at the transaction level.

_s_priceScoreSimpleMarginNetPrice_l.notes: Price score calculation using Simple Margin Based method and Net Price as Basis attribute.

_s_priceScoreSimpleMarginUnitCost_l.notes: Price score calculation using Simple Margin Based method and Unit Cost as Basis attribute.

_s_priceScoreSimpleMarginListPrice_l.notes: Price score calculation using Simple Margin Based method and List Price as Basis attribute.

_s_lineDiscountGuidanceFloor_l.notes: Lower bound of the line discount guidance.

_s_lineDiscountGuidanceCeiling_l.notes: Upper bound of the line discount guidance.

_s_lineDiscountGuidanceMax_l.notes: Max of the line discount guidance.

aBO_Delta_Action_Code_l.notes: An action code indicating whether a transaction line attribute has changed during an ABO operation.

_s_unitProratedOrderDiscount_l.notes: Prorated Order Level Discount Per Unit for the current line.

_s_totalProratedOrderDiscount_l.notes: Total Prorated Order Discount accounted for the current line.

_requestedRatePlan.notes: This menu attribute is populated with the list of available rate plans.

_txnRef_externalLineId_l.notes: Reference Identifier for the current line from the external system, for example: Commerce Cart or Self Service Cart.

_tax_taxPrice_l.notes: Tax amount for one unit of this line.

_tax_totalPrice_l.notes: The total price per unit of the item including taxes. If 'Is Tax Inclusive' is false, it is summation of Net Price per unit and tax per unit, otherwise it is same as Net Price per unit.

_tax_totalAmount_l.notes: Total Price for this line including taxes.

_tax_totalPriceMinusTax_l.notes: Total Price for this line excluding taxes.

_tax_totalAmountMinusTax_l.notes: Total Price for this line including taxes.

_tax_taxRollup_l.notes: The tax price of the item or for the root model rolled up to include all child values.

_tax_totalPriceRollup_l.notes: The total price of each item or for the root model rolled up to include all child values.

_tax_totalAmountRollup_l.notes: The total amount of the item or for the root model rolled up to include all child values.

_tax_totalContractPriceRollup_l.notes: The total amount for the contract duration for the root model rolled up to include all child values.

_shipping_shippingServiceLevel_l.notes: Shipping level of service to use to deliver the shipment.

_shipping_shipCarrierName_l.notes: The name of the carrier who ships and delivers the items.

_shipping_shipModeOfTransport_l.notes: The mode of transport to ship and deliver the item.

_shipping_shippingInstructions_l.notes: Instructions for the system on how to ship this item.

_shipping_shippingGroupId_l.notes: Identifier for the group of order lines in the order that ship together from one location to one destination, and that use the same scheduled ship date.

_shipping_shipToPartyId_l.notes: The Party ID for the Ship To Customer for this line. This attribute is used when a generalized Party object is used to identify customer parties.

_shipping_shipToPartySiteId_l.notes: The ID for the Party Site or Address of the Ship To party for this line.

_covered_item_uom.notes: To store the Unit of Measure attribute value of covered product in the coverage service line.

_s_orderLineId_l.notes: Order Line Id assigned by the external Order Management and ERP system

_s_prevAssetKey_l.notes: Oracle Internal Attribute. References the prior asset instance from which this line was created, during an ABO operation.

_s_origAssetKey_l.notes: Oracle Internal Attribute. References the first asset instance from which this line was created during an ABO operation.

_s_origRootAssetKey_l.notes: Oracle Internal Attribute. References the root asset key instance of the first asset instance from which this line was created, during an ABO operation.

_s_fulfilledQuantity_l.notes: For Future Use. The quantity of items fulfilled by the fulfillment system after the sales order is processed.

_s_cancelledQuantity_l.notes: For Future Use. The quantity of items cancelled by the fulfillment system after the sales order is processed.

_s_coveredItemFulfillmentLineId_l.notes: For Future Use. Fulfillment Line Id of the covered item.

_s_subscriptionNumber_l.notes: Subscription Number for the draft subscription line created during Create Subscription Integration.

_availableRatePlans.notes: This menu attribute is populated with the list of available rate plans.

totalShippingCost_l.notes: Total shipping cost for this line inclusive of taxes (for all quantities)

_s_newAssetKey_l.notes: Oracle Internal Attribute to store the generated new asset key when an asset instance is updated, renewed etc during an ABO operation.

_s_newRootAssetKey_l.notes: Oracle Internal Attribute used to store the generated new root asset key when an asset instance is updated, renewed etc during an ABO operation.

_s_prevRootAssetKey_l.notes: Oracle Internal Attribute. References the prior root asset instance from which this line was created, during an ABO operation.

_s_originalFulfillmentLineId_l.notes: Original Fulfilment order line reference from external system for an asset instance.

_s_closedDate_l.notes: The date on which the asset associated with this quote line was closed, during an ABO operation

_s_prevSubscriptionNumber_l.notes: The public key of the subscription created before amendment. Used only for subscription billing related transactions.

_s_prevSubscriptionProductPuid_l.notes: The public key of the subscription product created before amendment. Used only for subscription billing related transactions.

lineUpfrontAmount_l.notes: Amount to be collected for this line during checkout.

lineUpfrontAmountRollup_l.notes: Amount to be collected for this root line (and its child lines) during checkout.

_s_lineActionComment_l.notes: Captures remarks or comments provided during the execution of a line-level action on the asset or transaction.

_system_modify_order.notes: Current Modify Order - "1" for the first modify and "2" for the second modify

_auto_update_triggered_from.notes: Value available only for autoupdate function of the main document; specifies variable name of the attribute triggering auto update

_system_selected_document_number.notes: Document Number of selected line item

_system_filtered_document_numbers.notes: List of Filtered Document Numbers in line item

_mobile_device_enabled.notes: The Boolean value is "True" if the user is licensed for mobile, on a recognized mobile device, and on a mobile layout

_system_async_payload.notes: Asynchronous Payload from SOAP, transient value, only valid during receiving asynchronous calls

_system_transaction_is_locked.notes: Boolean value is "true" when the Transaction is locked for any user

_system_transaction_lock_user.notes: Name of user who locked the Transaction; if the Transaction is unlocked, the value is null

_system_transaction_locked_date.notes: Date the Transaction was locked; if the Transaction is unlocked, the value is null

_system_subscription_order_enabled.notes: Boolean value is "true" when the subscription order is enabled

_standard_abo_enabled.notes: Boolean value is "true" when the standard ABO is enabled
